l.i: Cogitationes alias odi, legem autem tuam diligo. Latebra & scutum meum es, in verbo tuo exspectationem habeo. Recedite à me malefici, ut custodiam præcepta DEI mei. Sustenta me secundùm sermonem tuum, ut vivam.
Conculcas omnes errantes à statutis tuis: quia falsus est dolus eorum.

page.notes: The "A" faintly visible near the foot of the text block, left of centre, may be a gathering signature. It is too faint to read with certainty, so it is not transcribed. The verse text may be set in italic throughout; it is marked as italic on that assumption. The verse differs from the Vulgate wording, so it is copied as printed.
